mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the neighbor link was most worthwhile: Asha's correction traveled back, and RECEIVED left her delivery open rather than falsely declaring it complete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The premature handset test was the least worthwhile decision; it failed because the gateway had not yet joined the radio link.

surprise.text: Tin Row's CLOSED needed mapping to RECEIVED, exposing a consequential disagreement about whether a request still needed help.

arbitrary.text: My attempts to connect the gateway and reporting port before preparing them were guesses; their prerequisites were not obvious to me, although the automatic compatibility feedback clarified them.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing how the two communities use the link, especially because the final test made the message-format issue concrete.
